div.p: This implementation guide contains simplified recommendations that illustrate the Clinical Practice Guidelines (CPG) implementation guide. The recommendations are intentionally not clinical, so demonstration applications can focus on the infrastructure for performing activities as part of guideline-directed care.

ul.li: a Library with the CQL logic that decides whether the recommendation applies,
a PlanDefinition whose action has that logic as applicability condition,
an ActivityDefinition describing the proposed activity, and
a set of test cases, each a Bundle with a Patient and the resources of one scenario.

div.p: The Examples page describes the recommendations and their test cases. The Artifact Index lists all resources.

Run PlanDefinition/$apply with a test case Bundle as the data parameter and Patient/<test case> as the subject, on a FHIR server with clinical reasoning support (such as HAPI FHIR) that has the conformance resources of this IG loaded. The result is a CarePlan that proposes the activity when the recommendation applies. The test case Bundles are included in this IG's package, so tools such as cpg-review can offer them as patients.
